access.deniedTitle: No access to the held stock reports
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the held stock report grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

columnHint.quantityAvailable: The quantity available at the group's latest refusal.
columnHint.sapFeedAge: How old the SAP stock feed was when the refusal was logged (h:mm:ss). On a group, the oldest of its rows.
columnHint.posFeedAge: How old the POS sales feed was when the refusal was logged (h:mm:ss). On a group, the oldest of its rows.
columnHint.lines: Picked lines whose last pick fell on the day and whose units carry more than one batch.
columnHint.channelToday: What the channels get today: Stock Visibility's ATP.
columnHint.held: Held, as Stock Visibility stands it: what serving held would subtract.
columnHint.channelWithHeld: What the channels would get with held subtracted, never below zero.
columnHint.takenOff: Channels today minus channels with held.
columnHint.fallsToZero: The channels have stock today and would have none.
columnHint.heldBeyondOpenPicks: Held minus the open picking documents' held units: sold holds waiting for their sale, door holds not yet confirmed, or a gap the check repairs. Negative when Stock Visibility is behind the pick tables.
columnHint.units: The held units on open picking documents of this source type.
columnHint.pairs: The store and material pairs this source type holds on.
columnHint.repairs: Each repair is a writer that forgot its ledger row.

list.failedTitle: The report could not be loaded
list.failed: Something went wrong reading the report. Try again in a moment.

export.doneDetail_one: {{n}} row was written to the workbook.
export.doneDetail_other: {{n}} rows were written to the workbook.
export.failedDetail: The workbook could not be written. Try again.

refusals.title: Take refusals
refusals.subtitle: One day of the take door's refusals, and a shadow store's would-be refusals, by store, material and batch with the feeds' ages; the lines that span batches; and each take of last-resort stock.
refusals.storesPlaceholder: Every open store, or e.g. P001, P002

unreached.hint: Stock Visibility did not return their refusal log, so their refusals are missing from this report, not zero:

tileHint.refused: Takes the door refused at a live store.
tileHint.wouldRefuse: Takes the door would have refused at a shadow store: nothing was refused.
tileHint.groups: Rows of the first tab: one per store, material, batch and kind.
tileHint.multiBatchLines: Picked lines of the day whose units carry more than one batch.
tileHint.lastResortTakes: Units that took DUMMY or the store's own DM placeholder batch.
tileHint.storesUnreached: Stores whose refusal log Stock Visibility did not return.

note.groups: Click a row to see its refusals. A shadow store's would-be refusals are never mixed with real ones. Feed ages are h:mm:ss.
note.rows: Every row of the log as Stock Visibility answered it, with the feed ages it was logged with.
note.multiBatch: A line counts on the day of its last pick. Empty until the door's batch is stamped on the unit.
note.lastResort: Last resort is DUMMY, or DM followed by the store's own code, on a unit with a take. Empty until the door's batch is stamped on the unit.

empty.multiBatch: No line spanned more than one batch on this day.
empty.lastResort: No take of last-resort stock on this day.

held.title: Held stock impact
held.subtitle: What held would take off the channels' figure, before held is served: per store and material, per picking source type with DRS on its own line, and the check's repairs per day.
held.storesPlaceholder: The fleet, or e.g. P001, P002
held.failed: Stock Visibility could not be read for every pair, so no figure is shown: a partial figure would mislead. Try again in a moment.

tileHint.pairs: Store and material pairs with a standing hold on an open picking document.
tileHint.pairsFallingToZero: Pairs whose channels have stock today and would have none.
tileHint.channelToday: Stock Visibility's ATP over the pairs: what the channels get today.
tileHint.held: Held over the pairs, as Stock Visibility stands it.
tileHint.takenOff: What serving held would take off the channels' figure.
tileHint.channelWithHeld: What the channels would get with held subtracted.
tileHint.repairs: The check on held's repairs over the range: each one is a writer that forgot its ledger row.

note.pairs: Only pairs with a hold on an open picking document are listed; a pair whose holds are only at Stock Visibility is not.
note.sources: The held units on open picking documents per source type, over the fleet. DRS is a line of its own.
note.repairs: The report's last line: the check on held's repairs per day, fleet-wide.

empty.pairs: No pair has a standing hold.
empty.repairs: The check made no repair in this range.
